CRIME NO.9/2022) BY THE IV ADDL CIVIL JUDGE AND JMFC-III COURT, VIJAYAPURA TO FACE TRIAL FOR THE OFFENCES PUNISHABLE U/S. 498A, 323, 504,
506 R/W SEC. 34 OF IPC AND ALL FURTHER PROCEEDINGS PURSUANT TO THE FILING OF THE CHARGESHEET AGAINST THE PETITIONER PRODUCED AT ANNEXURE-A.
 THESE PETITIONS COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

Since these petitions are filed challenging the proceedings arising out of the very same incident that has taken place on 16.01.2022, they are taken up together, heard and disposed of by this common order.

The petitioners in Criminal Petition No.200602/2023 are sought to be prosecuted for the offences punishable under Sections 341, 323, 324, 114, 307, 504, 506 R/w Section 34 of IPC, alleging that on 16.01.2022, they assaulted and abused the second respondent and CW.6 in filthy language.

sentences.text:
3 3 . The petitioner in Criminal Petition No.200993/2023 is sought to be prosecuted for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 R/w Section 34 of IPC, alleging that on 16.01.2022,
the petitioner-accused No.1, who is the husband of respondent No.2-De-facto complainant has subjected her to cruelty both mentally and physically and also abused her in filthy language and assaulted her.
4. These petitions are filed challenging the cognizance taken by the learned Magistrate of the aforesaid offences.

5. Parties are present before this Court and have filed the applications - I.A.2/2023 in Crl.P.
No.200602/2023 and I.A.1/2023 in Crl.P. No.200993/2023 under Section 482 of Cr.P.C., stating that the parties have amicably settled the dispute among themselves and respondent No.2-De-facto complainants have no objections for quashing the impugned proceedings.
The applications are placed on record.

6. Though the offences alleged are cognizable and non-compoundable, however, having regard to the fact that the parties have amicably settled the dispute among themselves, it will be a futile exercise, if the petitioners are subjected to trial, NC: 2023:KHC-K:5645 since the probability of their conviction is remote and bleak in view of the settlement.
Hence, the continuation of the criminal proceedings will be an abuse of process of law.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER i. I.A.2/2023 filed in Crl.P. No.200602/2023 and I.A.1/2023 filed in Crl.P.
No.200993/2023 are allowed.
Consequently, criminal petitions are allowed.
ii. The impugned proceedings in Criminal Case No.363/2023, arising out of Crime No.05/2022, registered by Jala Nagar Police Station, on the file of III Addl.
Senior
Civil Judge and JMFC Court, Vijayapura, and the proceedings in Criminal Case No.812023, arising out of Crime No.09/2022, registered by Vijayapura Women Police Station, on the file of IV Addl.
Civil Judge and JMFC-III Court, Vijayapura respectively, are hereby quashed.
iii. In view of disposal of the main petitions, pending interlocutory applications, if any, do not survive for consideration.

Sd/-
